'''Corinthia Hotels Limited''' (CHL), formerly ''Corinthia Hotels International'', based in [[Malta]], is the operator and developer for Corinthia hotels in Europe, Africa and The Middle East. CHL operates restaurants such as Rickshaw, and has a spa division. It is wholly owned by International Hotel Investments (IHI), which is part of the [[Corinthia Group of Companies]].<ref name="Corinthia Hotels About">{{cite web|url=http://www.corinthia.com/about-corinthia-hotels/|title=About Corinthia Hotels | Luxury Corinthia Hotels | Luxury Resorts|publisher=Corinthia Hotels|access-date=24 October 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141024154954/http://www.corinthia.com/about-corinthia-hotels/|archive-date=24 October 2014|url-status=dead}}</ref>

== History ==
Founded by [[Alfred Pisani]] and his family in [[Malta]] in 1962 the inaugural hotel, Corinthia Palace Hotel & Spa in [[Attard]], was first opened as a restaurant and was later developed into a hotel.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.ihiplc.com/our-portfolio-02/managed-hotels/managed-detail/CORINTHIA-PALACE-HOTEL-MALTA|title=CORINTHIA PALACE HOTEL, MALTA|website=www.ihiplc.com|access-date=2019-02-25|archive-date=2019-02-25|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190225224023/http://www.ihiplc.com/our-portfolio-02/managed-hotels/managed-detail/CORINTHIA-PALACE-HOTEL-MALTA|url-status=dead}}</ref> Pisani has been chairman since the company's inception.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.corinthia.com/en/about-us|title=About Corinthia {{!}} Corinthia Hotels International {{!}} Corinthia.com|website=www.corinthia.com|language=en-US|access-date=2018-08-29}}</ref>

Corinthia has hotels in locations including [[London]], [[Budapest]], [[Prague]], [[Saint Petersburg]], [[Lisbon]], [[Malta]] and Tripoli. Projects under the Corinthia Hotels brand are under development in Brussels,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.corinthia.com/en/hotels/brussels|title=Corinthia Hotel Brussels|website=www.corinthia.com|language=en-US|access-date=2018-08-29}}</ref> Dubai,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.corinthia.com/en/hotels/dubai|title=Corinthia Hotels {{!}} Corinthia Hotel Dubai|website=www.corinthia.com|language=en-US|access-date=2018-08-29}}</ref> Bucharest.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.corinthia.com/en/hotels/bucharest|title=Corinthia Hotel Bucharest|website=www.corinthia.com|language=en-US|access-date=2019-02-13}}</ref>
